audience: Busy male professionals 30–50, $100k+ income, frustrated with weight gain and fading energy. Already tried generic gym memberships and apps.
offer: 12-week 1-on-1 coaching program — custom training, nutrition, accountability calls 2x per week.
core_pain: Energy crash by 3pm every day. Pants fitting tighter every quarter. Feeling like they've lost the body they had at 25 and can't get it back.
transformation: Down 20+ lbs in 12 weeks. Steady energy from 6am to 10pm. Visible muscle definition. Confidence back.

tone: direct, confident, no-fluff, slightly contrarian. Sounds like a coach who's seen it all and isn't going to coddle you.
voice_examples: Most coaches will tell you to count macros. Don't. Most of my clients have never tracked a macro and they got better results.
If you're under 40 and can't squat your bodyweight, that's the first thing we fix.
I don't take everyone. The free strategy call is also my screening — if it's not a fit on either side, I'll tell you.
_notes_for_writer: If a sequence references a case study, use one of the proof_points entries — never invent.
If audience_temperature is 'cold', favor AIDA. If 'warm', favor PAS. If 'hot', favor direct.
Tone is direct/contrarian — avoid hype words, exclamation marks, or guru-speak.
When in doubt about price tier, default to the high-ticket booked-call template (offer is $4.8k, qualifies).
